page_title: MCI 1-0 SOU | Manchester City v Southampton 26/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+7' Substitution. Rico Lewis makes his way off the pitch and John Stones (Manchester City) comes on as his replacement.
90+6' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal was comfortably saved by Aaron Ramsdale.
90+5' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Southampton) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Tony Harrington has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
90+4' Southampton take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

90+4' Paul Onuachu (Southampton) latches onto a cross into the box from the wing and gets in a header. It went well towards the goal, but it was blocked by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play and Southampton have been awarded a corner kick.
90+3' Savinho (Manchester City) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.

90' Paul Onuachu (Southampton) latches on to a cross from the free kick and attempts to direct a bullet header into the middle of the goal. Ederson is alert, though, and makes a decent save to deny him.
88' Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) has tested the patience of referee Tony Harrington and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
87' A substitution has been made. Cameron Archer is replaced by Paul Onuachu (Southampton).
87' Russell Martin has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kamaldeen Sulemana (Southampton) replacing Flynn Downes.
86' Here comes a substitution. Matheus Nunes is given a rest as he is replaced by Ilkay Gundogan (Manchester City).
86' Manuel Akanji (Manchester City) drills a powerful shot from long range towards the middle of the goal, but Aaron Ramsdale makes a comfortable save.
84' Flynn Downes (Southampton) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
82' Flynn Downes (Southampton) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
80' James Bree (Southampton) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
80' Aaron Ramsdale (Southampton) is able to continue to play.
78' Aaron Ramsdale (Southampton) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
77' Substitution. Ryan Manning leaves the pitch and is replaced by James Bree (Southampton).
75' Adam Armstrong (Southampton) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit.
73' Phil Foden (Manchester City) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range but his effort is blocked.
70' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Southampton.
70' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Good work from Manchester City as they win a corner.
70' Phil Foden (Manchester City) fires the ball from distance, but it's blocked by a defender.
68' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Matheus Nunes (Manchester City). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
68' Manuel Akanji (Manchester City) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The linesman points to the corner flag, Manchester City are going to take it.
67' A corner kick by Manchester City is thwarted by the well prepared Aaron Ramsdale (Southampton).
63' What a wasted chance that was! A precise cross into the box finds Erling Haaland (Manchester City), whose header goes wide of the goal.
63' It looks like Jan Bednarek (Southampton) saw red with that tackle. Tony Harrington won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
61' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) drills in an effort from the edge of the box that climbs rapidly and goes high over the bar.
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Adam Lallana leaves the pitch and Joe Aribo (Southampton) comes on.
57' Adam Armstrong (Southampton) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
56' Adam Lallana (Southampton) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
55' Savinho (Manchester City) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.

53' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball went a few inches wide of the left post.
51' Adam Armstrong (Southampton) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the middle of the target, but Ederson easily deals with the threat.
50' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) meets a cross on the edge of the box and produces a header towards the right side of the goal, but one of the defending players blocks the effort.
50' Phil Foden (Manchester City) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
49' Phil Foden (Manchester City) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender. Manchester City will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
48' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Adam Armstrong (Southampton) was quite harsh and Tony Harrington didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
47' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Southampton was in an offside position.
46' Ooh that was close! Phil Foden (Manchester City) collects a pass and runs with pace goalwards before unleashing a great drive from the edge of the box, but it goes inches wide of the right post.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Russell Martin gives a chance to Adam Armstrong and Tyler Dibling (Southampton) is off.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' Cameron Archer (Southampton) creates a good chance for himself and fires in a powerful close-range shot, but his effort ricochets off the crossbar.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Phil Foden (Manchester City) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

44' The ball is out of play and Manchester City manage to earn a corner. Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) sets himself up and has a crack at goal from the edge of the box. The shot heads low to the middle of the goal, but Aaron Ramsdale tracks it all the way and makes an easy save.
43' Russell Martin appears to have said too much and referee Tony Harrington comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
42' Tony Harrington shows a yellow card to Flynn Downes (Southampton) for his blatant foul.
40' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
39' Phil Foden (Manchester City) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
38' Manchester City quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

37' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play. Manchester City are awarded a corner kick.
34' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
34' Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Aaron Ramsdale comes off his line to intercept.
32' Phil Foden (Manchester City) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

32' Manchester City have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. Manchester City have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
32' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. It will be a corner kick for Manchester City.
31' A lofted cross from Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
31' The corner from Phil Foden (Manchester City) is cleared away by the defence.
30' The corner is swung in but Manchester City can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. Corner kick. Manchester City will have an opportunity.
30' Savinho (Manchester City) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The ball goes out of play. Manchester City are awarded a corner kick.
30' Savinho (Manchester City) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
28' Savinho (Manchester City) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
26' Tony Harrington has a clear sight and sees a foul from Matheus Nunes (Manchester City).
24' Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
24' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
21' Ryan Manning (Southampton) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.

19' That was a poorly executed free kick from long distance. Phil Foden (Manchester City) was trying to produce a cross into the penalty area, but his effort sailed off the pitch. The ball goes out of play and Southampton will have a goal kick.
17' Manchester City enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
15' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
14' Phil Foden (Manchester City) takes the corner but it's cleared.
13' Savinho (Manchester City) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Manchester City force a corner. They send men into the box.
12' Tony Harrington blows for a foul after Erling Haaland (Manchester City) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
11' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) takes a shot from the edge of the area, but it goes harmlessly wide of the right post.
11' Adam Lallana (Southampton) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.

9' Savinho (Manchester City) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Aaron Ramsdale pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
8' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.

5' 1 - 0 Matheus Nunes sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Erling Haaland (Manchester City) latches on to it and finishes with a quick shot into the top of the net. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 1:0.

4' A nice pass finds Ruben Dias (Manchester City) in space. He sets himself up and hammers in a fantastic shot from distance that looks bound for the middle of the goal, but the out of position Aaron Ramsdale pulls off a breathtaking save to deny him.
3' Southampton are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
2' Manchester City are seeing far more of the ball now.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Manchester City will take the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Tony Harrington.
